question: Where is the position of the brows located relative to the hair end and the right line?
premises: A span is defined from the hair end to the right line.
The position of the brows is in the middle of these two.
inference: The brows should be positioned midway between the hair end and the right line.
uncertainties: dakṣisūtraṃ interpreted as a right-side reference line
